lines.a: 奇異恩典 何等甘甜
lines.b: Amazing Grace, how sweet the sound
That saved a wretch like me

lines.a: 前我失喪 今被尋回
lines.b: I once was lost but now am found
Was blind, but now I see

lines.a: 如此恩典 使我敬畏
lines.b: 'Twas Grace that taught my heart to fear
And Grace, my fears relieved

lines.a: 初信之時 即蒙恩惠
lines.b: How precious did that Grace appear
The hour I first believed

lines.a: 將來禧年 聖徒歡聚
lines.b: When we've been here ten thousand years
Bright shining as the sun

lines.a: 喜樂頌讚 在父座前
lines.b: We've no less days to sing God's praise
Than when we've first begun
Through many dangers, toils and snares
I have already come
'Tis Grace that brought me safe thus far
And Grace will lead me home
When we've been here ten thousand years
Bright shining as the sun
We've no less days to sing God's praise
Than when we've first begun
